findings.finding: Gold expects future_input but existing quantity assessment yields missing_observation when all future lines are rejected and coverage is absent.
findings.required_correction: Change reason to missing_observation and retain/assert both rejected_future assertion dispositions; do not change domain semantics to satisfy this gold label.

limitations: This is an independent agent review, not external procurement-expert certification.
Only one synthetic development project is reviewed; no held-out, retrieval, live-model, or application acceptance is established.
PO workbooks share identical bytes, but explicit distinct artifact/assertion/line identities in authority metadata establish independent lines. Dataset volume is not document diversity.
Gold source_rows are fixture aliases, not runtime evidence IDs; eventual evidence scorer must also validate authority records, role support, and complete admissible candidate inventory.
No explicit numeric ordered_quantity field exists in gold.json; reviewed eligible totals are retained here and should be asserted in public-caller tests.
